info.name: CredVault — Normal Vault & Critical Vault API
info.description:
My Vault (normal-vault, CRD-0001…) and Critical Vault (critical-vault, CCRD-0001…), with a create for each of the 25 credential types in both. Both vaults store into credvault_credentials; the vault column tells them apart. Rules and every endpoint: docs/CREDVAULT_API_SHEET.md §2.

BEFORE YOU START
1. php artisan migrate
2. Fill baseUrl, email/password (an employee with Credentials Vault → View), adminEmail/adminPassword (a client admin of the same company), managerEmail/managerPassword (that employee's reporting manager).
3. Run 00 · Setup, then the folders in order: later requests read the ids saved by earlier ones.

RESPONSES
Success: { status: true, data, tabs?, meta? }. Refusal: { status: false, message, errors? } with errors keyed by field. 403 not allowed · 404 not found / other vault · 409 state conflict · 410 email code expired · 422 validation · 423 locked / too many codes · 429 rate limit.

item.name: 01 · Generate Password
item.description:
POST /credvault/generate-password — the Generate Password popup, and the generate button in each password field. Nothing is stored: the password comes back once, with its strength.

Characters mode: length 8–64 (default: the policy's gen_length), upper / lower / numbers / symbols (symbols default: the policy's gen_symbols), avoid_ambiguous drops I O l o 0 1 (default on). At least one set must stay on.
Passphrase mode: 4–12 words (default 8), separator - . _ or space, capitalize (default on), add_number (default on).

Response: data.password, data.bits (entropy), data.level, data.strength (0–4, the form's meter), data.meets_policy.

02 · Add Normal Vault — 25 types
item.description:
POST /normal-vault/credentials — CRD-0001 … Risk low / medium / high (a type that defaults to critical starts at high). The 2FA switch is only recorded.

Every add is form-data with its files: attachments[0] and attachments[1] (up to 5) on the 19 types with the Attachments box; files[file] on Certificate and Document (required) and on Passport, Driver License, SSN / Aadhaar / PAN and Medical Record (optional). Pick the files before sending — an empty file row is left out.

13 · Share — person or team, with email
item.description:
POST /credentials/{id}/shares — the Share Credential popup. After the share is saved, an email goes out with the popup's details: the credential (name, ID, type, username, risk), the permission and what it allows, access until, the reason, and who shared it. Never a secret.

• Individual (recipient_type user): one email to that person.
• Team (recipient_type team, a department): one email to every active member of the team except the sharer, in Bcc (batches of 50).

Every share email is also copied (Cc) to php@inhpl.com (CREDVAULT_SHARE_COPY_EMAIL). The response's data.mail says what happened: status sent | partly_sent | failed | mail_off | no_recipients, with recipients, sent, failed and copy_to.

Shared By Me (GET /shares) returns the table's rows — sr_no, credential (code, created_on, name, url), recipient (name, initials, designation / team members), permission_label, shared_on {date, time}, expires {date, left}, reason, status_label, can {view, share, revoke} — with tabs, search, filters, sort and paging. A mail failure never undoes the share. The bell notification goes to the same people.
